svg.aria-label: One NB-IoT frame, resource element by resource element
svg.title: One NB-IoT frame, resource element by resource element
svg.text: One 10 ms frame of cell 260 (an even frame), square by square
140 OFDM symbols across (time) × 12 subcarriers up (frequency) = 1680 resource elements
NPSS: sync, same for every cell
NSSS: carries the cell ID (even frames)
Odd frames differ in two places: subframe 9 has NRS and data room instead of the NSSS, and subframe 4 has no SIB1 for this cell
(cells with an odd PCI put their SIB1 in odd frames). Subframes 1–3 and 6–8 are where the cell schedules NPDCCH (control) and NPDSCH
(data and the SI messages). The NRS positions follow PCI mod 6 = 2: subcarriers 2 and 8 in symbols 5 and 12, 5 and 11 in symbols 6 and 13.
